scope: Behavior and visual hooks only; imported art and source adoption are owned by the other task

art_source.license_evidence: Original team Blender Python modeling, no third-party inputs or generators, public redistribution allowed, no credit needed
art_source.material_policy: Read assigned imported material slots; optional explicit body_material/eyes_material/arm_material arguments. All must already be assigned lane materials.

taking_hooks.method: Additional presentation timer reads existing replicated Victim, VictimOrigin, ScareStyle and server TakingStarted; original mask and protected teleport remain intact
taking_hooks.hand: Imported full-scale arm reaches from in front, then retracts at the scheduled disappearance
taking_hooks.floor: Movable collision-free stylized slabs part over a dark render-only aperture; physical HZ floor is untouched
taking_hooks.light_cut: Imported shadow body lunges and nearby headlamps render black from the same schedule, restoring their logical power state automatically
taking_hooks.owning_camera: Existing victim-only fade remains untouched; presentation never changes another player's camera target
taking_hooks.primary_remaining_style_hook: TakePlayer reads NextPresentationStyle instead of independent RandomInteger: random server offset then three unique styles, resetting on each attempt

cave_being_hooks.class: BP_CaveBeing is a replicated child of existing BP_Ghost
cave_being_hooks.movement_collision_damage: Inherited unchanged, including server carrier targeting, damage, headlamp backoff and flare avoidance
cave_being_hooks.visual_initialization: An owned ActorComponent BeginPlay hides only old ghost visual meshes and keeps the tagged imported body visible, preserving parent Ghost BeginPlay and Tick
cave_being_hooks.speed: Authority component timer applies a one-time 1.12 multiplier after parent scaling; no repeated multiplication
cave_being_hooks.primary_remaining_wave_hook: Odd SpawnWave members call SpawnCaveBeingWaveMember(Location); even members retain the current ghost branch. Preserve roster count, timing, lifespan and cleanup.

required: Review source hash and exact writes/locks before primary editor execution
All imported meshes/materials ready before any hook asset changes
Compile touched/new Blueprints and save only exact owned packages
Check arm pivot, floor height, shadow-body direction, every client and both split views
Check blackout timing and restoration including taking interruption/retry
Check child parent movement/damage/light/flare behavior plus one-time speed scaling
Check mixed chase waves and cleanup at restart, completion and lifespan expiry
NullRHI cannot certify the scene, art, camera fade or sound
verification.not_claimed: Native node/pin validity, imported art acceptance, floor swallow body animation, rolling lamp prop, shader eye dim, physical device or Mac/network-emulation acceptance
